english:
Dealing Melee Damage grants the following for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds:
• 50% increased damage
• 20 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10% decreased Handling Animation Duration
• 10% decreased Damage Falloff Distance

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

source.text:
Upon dealing Melee Damage:
50% Increased damage, 10% Decreased Falloff Distance, +20 ↑+25 Handling, 0.9x Handling Duration Multiplier, +20 ↑+25 Reload Speed for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
